title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Billing Note: Rental Credit for an Unrepaired Light
content:
When a confirmed light-out of an **Area and Security Lighting Rental** light stays unrepaired more than 10 business days after the out-of-service date, the rental is credited, prorated by calendar days, for every calendar day from the out-of-service date through the day before the repair, period by period. A light whose outage was caused by the member's damage earns no credit.

## The clause read closely

- **When the clock starts.** The out-of-service date is the date of the confirmed report, as the light's record shows it.
- **When credit applies.** Credit applies only when the light stays unrepaired more than 10 business days after that date. A light repaired on or before the tenth business day after the out-of-service date earns no credit; a light still unrepaired after the tenth business day has passed earns it.
- **Which days are credited.** Once credit applies, every calendar day from the out-of-service date itself through the day before the repair is credited — the days before the threshold was crossed included. The repair day is not credited.
- **Period by period.** The credited days are split by billing period. Each billing period's credit is the fixture's monthly rental multiplied by the calendar days out that fall in that period, divided by the days of that billing period, rounded to the cent.
- **Member damage.** An outage caused by the member's damage earns no credit, however long it lasts.
- The credit is posted as a bill credit on the service account the light is billed on, one credit per outage for each billing period credited.

## Worked figures (hypothetical outages)

**One billing period.** An LED 70W Area Light, monthly rental 12.40, is confirmed out on the 3rd of a 30-day billing period and repaired on the 21st, having stayed unrepaired more than 10 business days. Days credited: the 3rd through the 20th, 18 days. Credit: 12.40 multiplied by 18, divided by 30, is 7.44.

**Two billing periods.** An LED 40W Security Light, monthly rental 9.85, is confirmed out on April 24 and repaired on May 9, having stayed unrepaired more than 10 business days.

| Billing period | Days in the period | Calendar days out in the period | Credit, rounded to the cent |
|---|---|---|---|
| April | 30 | April 24 through April 30: 7 | 9.85 multiplied by 7, divided by 30: 2.30 |
| May | 31 | May 1 through May 8: 8 | 9.85 multiplied by 8, divided by 31: 2.54 |

**No credit.** An LED 110W Flood Light is repaired on the eighth business day after its out-of-service date: it did not stay unrepaired more than 10 business days, so no day is credited. A fixture the member's guest damaged earns no credit whatever the length of the outage.

## Judgement table

| Unrepaired more than 10 business days after the out-of-service date | Outage caused by the member's damage | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Every calendar day from the out-of-service date through the day before the repair |
| Yes | Yes | None |
| No | No | None |
| No | Yes | None |
